Welcome to
Rhinoland Jungle Lodge for your Dream Stay
Deluxe standard Rhino Land Jungle Lodge offers you a separate package exclusively for touring Chitwan National Park, and helping you to navigate will be our own staff members - hand-picked individuals specialized in wildlife, bird-watching and tour guiding - to be your personal guides into your experience in Nepal’s most renowned National Park. This package includes Jungle walk, elephant back Safari, Jeep Safaris, Bird-Watching Tours, visit Elephant Breeding Center, Elephant Bathing and various other Jungle excursions.
Rooms And Suits
Pick a room that best suits your taste and budget
We have a variety of rooms here, including not only Deluxe Suites, Cabin style rooms, normal rooms, but also rooms in Machans – traditional Terai style houses built with wood. We have reinforced these traditional houses with modern building methods, that guarantee a safe and a completely and pleasantly different living experience. All the rooms are equipped with comfortable furniture, along with 24 hour hot water service, free wifi, telephone and highly professional room services. Besides these facilities granted to you, the breathtaking view of the Himalayas seen from these rooms are an added bonus that is sure to make your stay here all the more worthwhile.
Dive Into Refreshment & Relaxation
Enjoy crystal-clear water, a relaxing atmosphere, and a safe space
for all ages. Perfect for family fun, fitness, and relaxation.

Chitwan tower night stay package
Experience a Unique Tower Night Stay in Chitwan National Park
Looking for an unforgettable wildlife adventure in Nepal? Our Tower Night Stay Package in Chitwan National Park offers a rare opportunity to spend a night inside the jungle, surrounded by the sights and sounds of nature. This exciting experience allows you to observe wildlife from a secure observation tower while enjoying the peaceful atmosphere of Nepal's most famous national park.
Located in the heart of Chitwan National Park, the tower stay provides an authentic jungle experience for nature lovers, birdwatchers, wildlife photographers, and adventure seekers.
Highlights of the Tower Night Stay Package
Overnight stay in a jungle observation tower
Excellent opportunity to spot wildlife at night
Spectacular sunrise and sunset views
Guided jungle walk with experienced naturalists
Bird watching in one of Nepal's richest ecosystems
Traditional Tharu cultural experience (optional)
Safe and secure wildlife observation environment
Ideal for photographers and wildlife enthusiasts
Why Choose a Tower Night Stay in Chitwan?
A tower night stay is one of the most exciting activities available in Chitwan. Unlike a regular hotel stay, this experience places you directly within the wilderness, where you can listen to the calls of deer, monitor lizards, wild boars, and various bird species throughout the night.
The observation towers are strategically located near grasslands and water sources, increasing the chances of spotting wildlife. During your stay, you may encounter:
One-horned rhinoceros
Spotted deer
Wild boar
Barking deer
Various species of birds
Sloth bear (occasionally)
Leopard (rare sightings)
The peaceful jungle environment creates a truly memorable adventure that cannot be experienced from a standard lodge or resort.
Day 01 : As soon as you arrive at Sauraha Bus station or the Bharatpur Airport, you will be picked up by our hotel’s staff. When you reach the hotel, you’ll be given a brief introduction on your package, offered welcome drinks and allocateed to your rooms.
13:00 : You will be offered lunch.
15:00 : Embark on an exciting jungle walk through the wilderness of Chitwan National Park, accompanied by an experienced nature guide. As you explore the forest trails, keep an eye out for wildlife, bird species, and the rich biodiversity that makes the park famous.
Before reaching the view tower, our representative will deliver a packed dinner for you to enjoy during your stay. Spend an unforgettable night inside the jungle, surrounded by the sounds of nature and the unique atmosphere of Nepal's most renowned national park. From the safety of the view tower, you will have the opportunity to observe wildlife activity while experiencing the tranquility and adventure of a true wilderness overnight stay.
Day 02: 06:00 : Wake up with the natural sounds of the forest and start your day with an exciting wildlife viewing experience from the view tower. In the early morning hours, as the jungle awakens, you may have the chance to see a variety of birds, deer, and other wild animals moving through their natural surroundings. The calm atmosphere and soft morning light create perfect conditions for wildlife photography and nature observation. After spending a memorable morning immersed in the wilderness, make your way back to the hotel and enjoy a delicious breakfast while reminiscing about your unique overnight jungle experience.
07:00 : A tour guide will take you on a walk to the traditional Tharu village where you can observe their unique culture, dressup, architecture, language, lifestyle and the famous Mithila paintings.
09:30 : You will depart from Sauraha.
Note: Timing & Scheduels are subjected to change as per season.
Wildlife Photography Opportunities
The tower stay provides excellent opportunities for wildlife photography. Early mornings and late evenings are the best times to capture animals visiting nearby grasslands and waterholes. Bring your camera, binoculars, and telephoto lens for the best experience.
Best Time for Tower Night Stay
The best seasons for a tower night stay in Chitwan National Park are:
October to March: Pleasant weather and excellent wildlife visibility
April to May: Higher chances of wildlife sightings near water sources
September to November: Lush landscapes and abundant birdlife
Safety During Tower Stay
Your safety is our top priority. The observation towers are designed for secure wildlife viewing and are operated under the guidance of experienced naturalists and park authorities. Guests receive safety briefings before entering the tower area.
Who Can Join This Package?
This package is suitable for:
Nature lovers
Wildlife enthusiasts
Adventure travelers
Couples seeking a unique experience
Families with older children
Wildlife photographers
Birdwatchers
